module.name: holoscan-stereo-disparity
module.description: Disparity, depth and confidence from any rectified stereo pair (MONO8 or color, in host or GPU memory) and its stereo camera info, with NVIDIA VPI 4's stereo disparity estimator on the GPU (CUDA), or on the Optical Flow Accelerator and the PVA of Jetson Orin and Thor; the depth comes with its camera info, ready for a point cloud.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, for the cuda backend and the operator's kernels.

hardware.name: OFA
hardware.description: The Optical Flow Accelerator of Jetson Orin or Thor, for the ofa and pva backends (pva also uses the PVA). x86_64 hosts have none.

libraries.name: NVIDIA VPI
libraries.description: Runs the stereo disparity estimator on every backend.
